preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices within the tree.
The given graph is a tree, meaning it is connected and has no cycles.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the maximum number of paths in an i-valid set of paths for all i from 1 to n
postconditions.description: The output must provide the maximum number of paths for each k-valid set of paths, where k ranges from 1 to n.
